title: ADEPC website installation
lead: This sets up the site's database and the first admin account, then locks itself.
fixFirst: Fix the missing items (in cPanel: “Select PHP Version” or “MultiPHP INI Editor”), then reload this page.
databaseHelp: Create the database and its user in cPanel → “MySQL Databases”, give the user all privileges, then enter them here.
errorFields: Check the fields: all are required, the email must be valid and the password at least 10 characters.
errorWrite: Cannot write the configuration file in {path}.
errorToken: This form has expired. Reload the page and try again.
errorNotEmpty: This database already contains an installed ADEPC site. Use an empty database.
doneLead: The site and the admin are ready. For safety, delete the “install” folder from public_html.
already: The site is already installed. This installer is locked.
